display.purpose: Brand name, section markers. Always uppercase, widest tracking.

headline.purpose: Section headlines. Negative tracking at scale for visual density.

title.purpose: Package names, client names. Uppercase for labels.

label.purpose: Chips, badges, CTA buttons. Always uppercase, cinematic stamp.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Ambient gold glow on primary conversion elements (Scale package, CTA button). Never decorative.

shadows.name: accent-glow-sm
shadows.purpose: Smaller gold glow for hover states and active chips.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for entrances and state changes. Close to ease-out-quart.

motion.name: duration-exit
motion.purpose: Exit animation duration. Snappier than entrance.

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: Delay between sequential element entrances in a group.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Screen Gold pill, uppercase, bold. The decisive action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f8d17d; color: #1c1917; padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Geist Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f0c06a; transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 0 20px -5px #f8d17d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f8d17d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary controls in modal and overlays. Transparent, appears on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #fafafa; padding: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Geist Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s, color 0.3s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #f8d17d; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f8d17d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Category Chip (Active)
components.description: Selected category filter. Screen Gold fill marks the active view.
components.css: .ds-chip-active { background: #f8d17d; color: #1c1917; padding: 8px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Geist Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border: 1px solid #f8d17d; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 20px -5px #f8d17d; transition: all 0.3s; }

components.name: Category Chip (Inactive)
components.description: Unselected category filter. Muted, awaiting selection.
components.css: .ds-chip-inactive { background: transparent; color: #71717a; padding: 8px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Geist Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s; } .ds-chip-inactive:hover { border-color: #27272a; color: #a1a1aa; }

components.name: Video Card
components.description: 9:16 portrait card. Poster at rest, hover-to-play, bottom gradient overlay with client/title.
components.html: WEARWOLFE Clever Coyote Highlight
components.css: .ds-video-card { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 9/16; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: #18181b; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.3s; } .ds-video-card:hover { border-color: rgba(248,209,125,0.5); } .ds-video-poster { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-size: cover; background-position: center; } .ds-video-play { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-video-play svg { color: #1c1917; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-left: 4px; opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.5); transition: all 0.3s; } .ds-video-card:hover .ds-video-play svg { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } .ds-video-info { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; padding: 20px; padding-top: 48px; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.95), rgba(0,0,0,0.6), transparent); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s; } .ds-video-card:hover .ds-video-info { opacity: 1; } .ds-video-client { display: block; font-family: Geist Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f8d17d; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-video-title { display: block; font-family: Geist Sans, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #fafafa; line-height: 1.3; }

components.name: Pricing Card (Default)
components.description: Standard pricing tier. Flat, tonal surface with subtle border.
components.html: STARTER PACKAGE $1,000 4 Videos

narrative.overview: Every frame is selected. Every piece earns its place. The site functions as a curated archive of cinematic work, not a freelancer's highlight reel. Dark, warm, unhurried. Visitors enter a space where the portfolio breathes and the interface recedes. The system is committed-dark: a warm near-black canvas that lets the Screen Gold accent mark decisive moments. Tonal layering, not shadows, creates depth. Surfaces are flat at rest; the only glow belongs to the accent. Typography is uppercase and tracked-out at small sizes, giving labels and navigation a cinematic stamp. At display scale, the same family tightens its tracking for impact. The overall density is low, with generous negative space treating the viewport like a gallery wall. This system explicitly rejects cookie-cutter freelancer portfolios with their stock vibes and template layouts, bloated agency sites that prioritize spectacle over substance, and neon club flyer aesthetics where flash substitutes for taste.
keyCharacteristics: Dark warm canvas with tonal layering, no structural shadows
Single accent (Screen Gold) used sparingly at decision points and highlights
Uppercase tracked labels as cinematic stamps throughout
9:16 portrait video cards as the signature format
Generous negative space, low visual density
Framer Motion for entrance choreography only, no decorative animation

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Screen Gold is the only saturated color on the page. It appears at decision points (buttons, active chips, client labels, package highlights) and never as decoration. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Warm Dark Doctrine
rules.body: Every neutral, from the deepest black to the lightest gray, carries a chroma of 0.005 to 0.015 toward hue 80 (warm amber). Pure #000 or #fff is prohibited. The warmth is subtle but structural.

rules.name: The Uppercase Stamp Rule
rules.body: Any text at 0.75rem or 0.875rem that functions as a label, badge, or navigation element is set uppercase with 0.1em letter-spacing. This is the signature type treatment.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only shadow-like effect is the Screen Gold glow on primary conversion elements. If a card appears to float, the background shade is wrong, not the shadow.

dos: Do use Screen Gold only at decision points: primary buttons, active chips, client labels, and package highlights.
Do warm-tint every neutral toward hue 80 with chroma 0.005 to 0.015.
Do use tonal layering (stepping background lightness) instead of shadows to convey depth.
Do set labels and navigation text uppercase with 0.1em tracking for the cinematic stamp.
Do keep the video card as the signature component: 9:16 portrait, hover-to-play, bottom gradient overlay.
Do cap body line length at 65ch for readable prose.
Do use exponential ease-out curves for all motion.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or callouts.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient.
Don't add glassmorphism as a default surface treatment.
Don't use the hero-metric template (big number, small label, gradient accent).
Don't create identical card grids repeating the same pattern endlessly.
Don't add structural box-shadows to cards at rest.
Don't use cookie-cutter freelancer portfolio patterns, bloated agency spectacle, or neon club flyer aesthetics.
